description: Modules 11+12 — Notifications/Webhooks (WebhookEvent, SNS, HMAC signatures, retry) and Audit/Logging (AuditEvent, MDC filter, structured logging)
steps: Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/notification/entity/WebhookEvent.java — JPA entity extending BaseEntity. Fields: ingestionRequest (@ManyToOne), eventType (NotificationEventType enum), recipientType (String — 'PARTNER' or 'INSURER'), recipientId (UUID), deliveryMethod (String — 'WEBHOOK' or 'SNS'), payload (@Column(columnDefinition='jsonb')), status (String — 'PENDING', 'DELIVERED', 'FAILED'), httpStatusCode (Integer), responseBody (TEXT), retryCount (int default 0), lastAttemptedAt (Instant), deliveredAt (Instant). Table: webhook_events

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/notification/repository/WebhookEventRepository.java — findByIngestionRequestId, findByStatusAndRetryCountLessThan(String status, int maxRetries) for retry scheduler

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/notification/service/NotificationService.java interface — sendNotification(UUID ingestionRequestId, NotificationEventType eventType, UUID recipientId, String recipientType)

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/notification/service/WebhookNotificationServiceImpl.java — implements NotificationService for WEBHOOK delivery. deliverWebhook: (1) load insurer or partner for webhookUrl and webhookSecret; (2) build payload JSON: { eventType, ingestionRequestId, timestamp, data }; (3) compute HMAC-SHA256 signature of payload using webhookSecret; (4) HTTP POST to webhookUrl with header X-Webhook-Signature: sha256={signature}; (5) record WebhookEvent with result; (6) retry up to 3 times on failure with exponential backoff (use @Retryable from spring-retry — but spring-retry is NOT in pom.xml, so implement retry manually with a loop and Thread.sleep). Use java.net.http.HttpClient for webhook delivery

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/notification/service/SnsNotificationServiceImpl.java — implements NotificationService for SNS delivery. Uses SnsClient @Bean from AwsConfig. Publishes message to insurer's snsTopicArn. If snsTopicArn is null/empty, skip SNS and log a warning

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/notification/service/NotificationOrchestrator.java — @Service. Called after status changes. sendNotificationsForStatus(UUID ingestionRequestId, IngestionStatus status): (1) load IngestionRequest; (2) based on status, determine which event type to fire (TRANSFER_COMPLETED → DOCUMENT_TRANSFER_COMPLETED, COMPLETED → PROCESSING_COMPLETED, VALIDATION_FAILED → VALIDATION_FAILED); (3) notify insurer via SNS if configured; (4) notify insurer via webhook if webhookUrl configured; (5) notify partner via webhook if partner has webhookUrl field — NOTE: partners table doesn't have webhookUrl in V1 migration, skip partner webhook notification for now or add a check
Update TransferJobServiceImpl to call NotificationOrchestrator after status transitions

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/audit/entity/AuditEvent.java — JPA entity (NOT extending BaseEntity — audit records are immutable, use a simple @Id UUID + @Column). Fields: id (UUID @Id @GeneratedValue), entityType, entityId, action (AuditAction enum), actorType (String), actorId (String), oldValue (@Column(columnDefinition='jsonb')), newValue (@Column(columnDefinition='jsonb')), details (TEXT), ipAddress (String), createdAt (Instant, @CreatedDate or manually set). Table: audit_events

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/audit/service/AuditService.java interface + AuditServiceImpl.java — recordEvent(String entityType, String entityId, AuditAction action, String actorType, String actorId, Object oldValue, Object newValue, String details, String ipAddress). Use ObjectMapper to serialize old/new values to JSON. Always @Transactional(propagation=REQUIRES_NEW) so audit records are saved even if the main transaction rolls back

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/common/logging/MdcLoggingFilter.java — OncePerRequestFilter. Runs before authentication. Sets MDC: requestId (UUID.randomUUID().toString()), incoming X-Request-Id header if present. After JWT auth filter has run, also sets partnerId from SecurityContext if available. Clears MDC in finally block
Update SecurityConfig to add MdcLoggingFilter FIRST in the filter chain (before JwtAuthenticationFilter)
Run mvn compile and mvn test — fix all errors
acceptance_criteria: Webhook HMAC-SHA256 signature is computed and sent in X-Webhook-Signature header
Webhook delivery retries up to 3 times on failure
AuditService uses REQUIRES_NEW propagation so audit records persist even if main tx rolls back
MDC filter sets requestId at start of every request
AuditEvent table does not use BaseEntity (audit records are immutable)
